exact_source_findings: ConversationSegmentStore.put mutates in-memory state before _save_locked and _save_locked swallows persistence failure; caller cannot prove durable publication.

handle_openai_responses currently writes TurnAffinityStore before ConversationSegmentStore. If durable conversation publication fails, a same-process retry can hit the semantic affinity cache and re-render the uncommitted tool recommendation with a fresh call_id.
responses_payload allocates response/item/call IDs at render time, so semantic completion_text cache is not protocol-idempotent.
Codex tool-call output must not be exposed when conversation_key is missing because there is no durable replay identity to bind the side effect to.

stream_openai_responses currently emits response.created before replay/durable publication is decided. Streaming must emit no Responses identity before preflight/publication; SSE comment keep-alives are identity-free and can preserve the connection while provider work is buffered.
v3_self_review_rejection: The first v3 candidate kept TurnAffinityStore publication before durable conversation publication; this leaves an unsafe same-process retry path after disk failure.

A shallow previous_items snapshot is insufficient if cleanup mutates existing ConversationSegment objects in place while expiring replay payloads. Candidate implementation should replace dataclass values instead of mutating shared objects, or take a deep snapshot.
A tool call with conversation_key=None must fail closed before affinity publication or client exposure.

proved: forced durable failure returns 503 with no affinity cache and no exposed response
tool call without durable conversation identity returns 503 with no affinity cache and no exposed response
final text remains compatible with clients that lack a Codex conversation identity

retention_policy_candidate.expiry_behavior: retain replay request fingerprint but remove replay payload; later exact retry fails closed instead of re-planning
